query: Add monitoring support for a new Plex media server instance — health check and basic stats (active streams, library count).
expected_behavior: Reads docs/guides/adding-services.md and the relevant docs/integrations/ spec before writing code, per the skill's mandate
Creates a new class in apps/backend/src/domain/services/ that extends BaseService and implements checkHealth() and getStats()
Registers and starts the new service through bootstrap/registerServices.ts and ServiceLifecycle
Uses existing src/infra/ building blocks (http/cache/circuitBreaker/scheduler) rather than hand-rolling transport or polling logic
Stores the Plex configuration in DuckDB through /config or the UI instead of adding environment variables
